about: Measured from the rendered dog layer of each scene frame (ink centroid and extent); facing/posture are the labels of the library drawing on screen (mirror applied). x_ink_m = ink centroid mapped back to metres; bbox_*_m = ink extent in metres.
mapping: screen_x = 415 + 150 * x (camera static until 19 s, then a push-in; x_ink_m undoes the camera)
